mentions.name: Calm tile-matching game
mentions.description: A calm, ad-free tile-matching game for iOS designed for winding down before bed. The first 15 minutes are playable, followed by a 6-hour break, with unlimited play unlocked via a reasonably-priced one-time purchase instead of a subscription.
mentions.problem: Existing puzzle games the author played before bed were visually loud and ad-ridden, not optimal for winding down.
mentions.source_excerpt: So, experiment time: I've created a basic, calm tile-matching game. Now I play that at night. I'm going to post this one to the iOS store and see what happens. First 15 minutes are playable, then a 6 hour break. Or you upgrade for unlimited play, via a reasonably-priced one time purchase.
